bio: Welcome to Gilbert von Berg's creative space. Watch him in action in the open kitchen of his stylishly rugged, nature-inspired restaurant, where he brings his culinary vision to life. He has surrounded himself with a fantastic team so that he can focus on his cooking. The apparent complexity of his sophisticated creations at times belies their simplicity. It is the intensity of the flavours is key here. His ingredient-led cuisine takes its cue from the seasons: more Asian in summer, more French in winter etc. Local produce is given pride of place, and non-native ingredients only feature if they make a valid contribution. For example, the chef elevates confit skate wing with Chinese pointed cabbage – both marinated and raw – briny cockles, oyster leaf and a plankton-infused beurre blanc. On...
